hero.title: Madrid Cricket Club
hero.subtitle: Cricket in the Heart of Spain
hero.description: A community of cricket lovers playing competitive cricket in and around Madrid since 2008. Join us — all abilities welcome.

join.title: Play for Madrid CC
join.description: Whether you're an experienced player or just starting out, we have a place for you. We field a senior side in the Liga Nacional and run junior coaching sessions.

history.title: Our History
history.content: Madrid Cricket Club was founded in 2008 by a group of expats and Spanish cricket enthusiasts who wanted to play competitive cricket in the Spanish capital. Since then we have grown steadily, now competing in the Liga Nacional División 2 and running a junior programme.

ground.title: Our Ground
ground.description: We play our home fixtures at the Casa de Campo cricket ground, one of the finest club grounds in Spain, set in Madrid's beautiful western parkland.

affiliation.title: Cricket España
affiliation.description: MCC is affiliated to Cricket España, the national governing body, and all our players are registered and insured under the national scheme.

join.title: Join Madrid Cricket Club
join.subtitle: We welcome players of all abilities — senior and junior.
